VERIFIED

Why sourcing coupons usually hurts

Dead codes reach customers

Gray-market or unverified stock means codes that fail at the counter — and a support ticket for every one.

You commit to the wrong merchant

Buy a block of one merchant's vouchers, and if the campaign shifts you are stuck with inventory you cannot use.

No supply when demand surges

A promotion takes off and there is nothing left to hand out, or sourcing more takes weeks.

The play

How sourcing from the pool works

  1. 1

    Scope

    Set your volume and the categories you need, and choose redemption-base or full purchase.

  2. 2

    Reserve

    Commit at a discount and we reserve verified merchant inventory from the pool. Undistributed Passes stay swappable.

  3. 3

    Draw on demand

    Pull from your reserved pool into your own app by API as customers claim — they never see Mezzofy. Or hand out Passes through Vault for pilots.

  4. 4

    Swap and reconcile

    Exchange undistributed inventory for another seller's at the same value, and reconcile every draw and redemption to settlement.

What the pool gives you

Verified at source

Every merchant is onboarded and verified before inventory enters the pool, and every Pass is validated before it reaches your app.

Reserve now, draw later

Hold a pool against a commitment and draw from it as demand arrives — REST and MCP, sandbox on signup.

Swap what you do not use

Your commitment is to the exchange, not to one merchant. Exchange undistributed Passes for another's at the same value.

Reconcilable to settlement

Draw, distribution and redemption per Pass, per merchant and per campaign, in the portal and by API.

Why the pool beats one-off sourcing

No dead codes, no tickets

Verified at source, with 99.9% validation uptime and auto-credit on the rare failure.

Inventory that flexes with demand

Reserve ahead, draw on demand, and swap whatever a campaign shifts away from.

Procurement-ready

Security documentation, uptime commitments and data residency options, provided during procurement.

Frequently Asked Questions

What if a campaign changes after I commit?

Undistributed Passes can be swapped for another seller's at the same value. Your commitment is to the exchange, not one merchant.

How fast can I go live?

Pass-and-Vault distribution can be live in days; a full API integration is typically two to four weeks including certification, with a sandbox from day one.

How do I distribute to my customers?

Draw by API into your own app so customers never see Mezzofy, or hand out Passes through the Vault for pilots and short campaigns.

What about failed redemptions?

Every Pass is validated before it reaches a customer, and on the rare failure the customer is credited automatically.
